# 1. Introduction
This analysis collects and preprocesses CAD/JPY exchange rates and macroeconomic data from Canada and Japan.



# 2. Libraries
```{r libraries}
library(quantmod)
library(WDI)
library(tidyverse)
```



# 3. Data Collection
## 3.1 CAD/JPY Exchange Rate
```{r exchange_rate_data}
# Obtain CAD/JPY exchange rates
getSymbols(
  "CADJPY=X",
  src = "yahoo",
  from = "2004-01-01",
  to = "2024-01-01"
)


# Remove missing values
cad_jpy <- na.omit(`CADJPY=X`)


# Calculate annual average exchange rates
cad_jpy_data <- data.frame(
  date = index(cad_jpy),
  cad_jpy = as.numeric(cad_jpy[, "CADJPY=X.Close"])
) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(format(date, "%Y"))) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    cad_jpy = mean(cad_jpy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Keep data from 2004 to 2023
cad_jpy_data <- cad_jpy_data %>%
  filter(year <= 2023)
```


## 3.2 Macroeconomic Data
```{r macroeconomic_data}
# Obtain macroeconomic data from WDI
macro_data <- WDI(
  country = c("CA", "JP"),
  indicator = c(
    "NY.GDP.MKTP.CD",  # GDP
    "FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG",  # Inflation rate
    "SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS"   # Unemployment rate
  ),
  start = 2004,
  end = 2023
)
```


## 3.3 Organize Macroeconomic Data
```{r organize_macro_data}
# Select and rename variables
wide_macro_data <- macro_data %>%
  select(
    year,
    iso2c,
    gdp = NY.GDP.MKTP.CD,
    infl = FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG,
    unemp = SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = iso2c,
    values_from = c(gdp, infl, unemp)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)
```


# 4. Data Integration
```{r data_integration}
# Merge exchange rates and macroeconomic indicators
df <- left_join(
  wide_macro_data,
  cad_jpy_data,
  by = "year"
)


# Check missing values
colSums(is.na(df))
```


# 5. Export Processed Data
```{r export_data}
# Export processed dataset
write.csv(
  df,
  "processed_data.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
